fields.title: Clutch.co record
fields.description: Every record carries _input, _source, _scrapedAt and recordType. recordType is PROVIDER for an agency row in a category listing, PROFILE for a full agency profile, REVIEW for one client review, CATEGORY for a directory URL from the sitemap, SURFACE for a reference probe and ERROR for a failure. On a PROVIDER record, isRankedResult tells you whether the row is part of the category's ranked list at all: a page also carries sponsor rows (paid) and a Leaders Matrix block that repeats on every page.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The category or profile you passed in that produced this record.

_source.title: Source
_source.description: clutch-directory | clutch-profile-ldjson | clutch-profile-reviews | clutch-sitemap | reference | error.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: PROVIDER | PROFILE | REVIEW | CATEGORY | SURFACE | ERROR.

providerId.title: Provider ID
providerId.description: Clutch's own numeric id for the agency, stable across categories and pages.

providerUuid.title: Provider UUID
providerUuid.description: The UUID Clutch uses in review share links, present on profile and review records.

profileUrl.title: Profile URL
profileUrl.description: Canonical clutch.co profile page for the agency.

profileSlug.title: Profile slug
profileSlug.description: The slug you can pass back into the profile or reviews mode.

website.title: Website
website.description: The agency's own site. Clutch hides it behind a redirect; this is the real destination, UTM tags included as the source wrote them.

websiteDomain.title: Website domain
websiteDomain.description: Host of the website with any leading www stripped - the join key for enrichment.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Clutch's own paragraph about the agency, as shown on the listing.

description.title: Description
description.description: The agency's own pitch, from the profile page.

rowType.title: Row type
rowType.description: Directory (the ranked list), Sponsor, featured, or Leaders Matrix - the source's own label for why the row is on the page.

positionOnPage.title: Position on page
positionOnPage.description: Position within its block on that page, not a global rank.

pageNumber.title: Page number
pageNumber.description: Which page of the category the row came from. Page 1 is the bare URL.

isPaidPlacement.title: Paid placement
isPaidPlacement.description: True for sponsor and featured rows. On page 1 of a busy category, half the rows are paid.

isPinnedBlock.title: Pinned block
isPinnedBlock.description: True for rows that repeat identically on every page of the category (Leaders Matrix, featured). Deduplicated within a run.

isRankedResult.title: Ranked result
isRankedResult.description: True only for rows that are part of the category's actual ranking, about 50 per page.

ratingValue.title: Rating (microdata)
ratingValue.description: The same score as the page's structured data states it.

isVerified.title: Verified
isVerified.description: Whether the row carries a Clutch verification mark.

verificationLabel.title: Verification label
verificationLabel.description: The verification mark's own class, which names the tier (for example premier).

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Per-service Clutch certifications with the dates they were issued and expire.

minProjectSize.title: Min. project size
minProjectSize.description: The floor the agency will take on, e.g. '$10,000+'. The single most filtered attribute in this vein.

hourlyRate.title: Hourly rate
hourlyRate.description: Rate band as shown, e.g. '$50 - $99 / hr'.

priceRange.title: Price range
priceRange.description: The same band as the page's structured data states it, without the '/ hr' suffix.

location.title: Location
location.description: Headquarters as printed on the row, e.g. 'Raleigh, NC'.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Profile only - the locations line from the summary strip.

telephone.title: Telephone
telephone.description: Business switchboard as published by the agency on its own listing.

yearFounded.title: Year founded
yearFounded.description: As printed on the profile summary strip.

services.title: Service mix
services.description: Service lines with the share of the agency's work each accounts for, e.g. [{service: 'Web Development', percent: 25}].

servicesOffered.title: Services offered
servicesOffered.description: Profile only - the service catalogue as the page's structured data lists it.

serviceLines.title: Service lines
serviceLines.description: Profile only - service split with percentages and the category URL for each line.

focusAreas.title: Focus areas
focusAreas.description: Profile only - the finer breakdown (frameworks, platforms, AI expertise) with percentages.

industries.title: Industries
industries.description: Profile only - industry split with percentages.

clientSizes.title: Client sizes
clientSizes.description: Profile only - client-size split, when the profile publishes one.

categoryUrl.title: Category URL
categoryUrl.description: The listing this row came from, or the directory URL itself on a CATEGORY record.

totalCompaniesClaim.title: Companies in category
totalCompaniesClaim.description: How many agencies the category page says it holds.

lastPageInPager.title: Last page
lastPageInPager.description: Highest page number the pager links to - how deep this category goes.

countryCode.title: Country code
countryCode.description: CATEGORY records - set when the URL is a country cut such as /id/web-developers.

categorySlug.title: Category slug
categorySlug.description: CATEGORY records - the slug to pass into the directory mode.

refinements.title: Refinements
refinements.description: CATEGORY records - the extra path segments, such as a city or an industry.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: CATEGORY records - number of path segments.

isRootCategory.title: Root category
isRootCategory.description: CATEGORY records - true for a global category with no country or refinement.

sitemapShard.title: Sitemap shard
sitemapShard.description: CATEGORY records - which sitemap file listed this URL.

reviewId.title: Review ID
reviewId.description: Clutch's own id for the review, stable across pages.

providerName.title: Agency name
providerName.description: REVIEW records - the agency being reviewed.

providerReviewCount.title: Reviews on profile
providerReviewCount.description: REVIEW records - how many reviews the profile claims in total, to check coverage.

title.title: Review title
title.description: REVIEW records - the project the review is about.

isFeatured.title: Featured review
isFeatured.description: REVIEW records - pinned to the top of the profile, and repeated on later pages.

projectSize.title: Project size
projectSize.description: REVIEW records - what the client spent, e.g. '$50,000 to $199,999' or 'Confidential'.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: As the page prints it, e.g. 'Aug 12, 2024'.

reviewerPosition.title: Reviewer role
reviewerPosition.description: Role and company of the person who left the review, as published.

reviewerName.title: Reviewer name
reviewerName.description: Byline as published on the review, or absent when the client stayed anonymous.

isVerifiedReviewer.title: Verified reviewer
isVerifiedReviewer.description: Whether Clutch marks the reviewer's identity and the project as confirmed.

reviewsOnPage.title: Reviews on page
reviewsOnPage.description: PROFILE records - how many review blocks the first page rendered.

hasLdJson.title: Structured data present
hasLdJson.description: PROFILE records - false means the profile rendered without its structured-data block and the record fell back to HTML.

check.title: Check
check.description: SURFACE records - which assumption was re-tested.

where.title: Where
where.description: ERROR records - the URL or step that failed.

overview.title: Agency leads
overview.description: The attributes a buyer filters on, one row per agency.

placement.title: Paid vs earned
placement.description: Which rows are bought placement and which are the category's actual ranking.

contact.title: Contact & location
contact.description: Where each agency is and how to reach it.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Client reviews with the four sub-ratings and what the project cost.

categories.title: Directory index
categories.description: Valid directory URLs to feed back into the directory mode.
